text: 你看见一个垂死的变种人。
source_text: 你看见一个垂死的变种人。

text: You see the body of a mutant.
source_text: You see the body of a mutant.

text: 你看见一具变种人的尸体。
source_text: 你看见一具变种人的尸体。

text: It was so fast... My brothers were gone... Could not help...
source_text: It was so fast... My brothers were gone... Could not help...

text: 这来得太快了……我的兄弟都走了……没用了……
source_text: 这来得太快了……我的兄弟都走了……没用了……

text: I, I'm... I can't remember... Was the leader of... It... Maybe my holodisk... 【The mutant weakly hands you a bloody Holodisk】
source_text: I, I'm... I can't remember... Was the leader of... It... Maybe my holodisk... 【The mutant weakly hands you a bloody Holodisk】

text: 我，我是……我记不起来了……是……的领导……也许我的全息磁盘……【变种人用无力的手交给你一张带血的全息磁盘】
source_text: 我，我是……我记不起来了……是……的领导……也许我的全息磁盘……【变种人用无力的手交给你一张带血的全息磁盘】

text: We... We were scouting for primes... Came from... From the northwest.
source_text: We... We were scouting for primes... Came from... From the northwest.

text: 我们……我们为精英部队作侦察……来自于……西北方。
source_text: 我们……我们为精英部队作侦察……来自于……西北方。

text: Father... Where are you father?... Yes Master... 【The mutant breathes his last breath and collapses】
source_text: Father... Where are you father?... Yes Master... 【The mutant breathes his last breath and collapses】

text: 父亲……你在哪儿父亲？……是的，主教……【变种人咽下最后一口气，解脱了】
source_text: 父亲……你在哪儿父亲？……是的，主教……【变种人咽下最后一口气，解脱了】
